headline: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson Suffers Ankle Injury
summary: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson exited Sunday’s win over the Titans just before halftime with an ankle injury, raising uncertainty about his availability for next Monday’s matchup with the Falcons. summary: Multiple reports have suggested the Lions want to hammer out an extension with tight end Sam LaPorta, who is in the final year of his rookie contract. headline: Tetairoa McMillan, Bryce Young star as Panthers defeat Lions
summary: Carolina receiver Tetairoa McMillan was dominant in his team's 32-36 win over Detroit Lions Sunday night, catching 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns from teammate Bryce Young, who threw for 329 yards to help the Panthers even their record at 2-2.

headline: Lions' Campbell won't discuss dismissing DC Sheppard after loss
summary: Despite the Lions' defense's continued slide, Dan Campbell and his players refused to blame second-year defensive coordinator Kelvin Sheppard after their loss Sunday night to the Panthers.

headline: Chargers' Jim Harbaugh says OC Mike McDaniel's job 'not in jeopardy'
summary: After another poor offensive performance Sunday, Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh is standing by offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel.
